temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that he has been hiding something and that he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him; Christian feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian's suspicion is confirmed, and he learns that Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been keeping a serious trouble from him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious before the admission; worried and concerned after.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To understand what Jonathan is hiding and uncover the truth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but accepts that he needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian learns that Jonathan's trouble is complicated and risky, and that Jonathan needs support/resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and needs Christian's help and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan however he can.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, admits he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but says he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and needs help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian begins to believe Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or dangerous people.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with the wrong people or criminal activity, though Jonathan denies personal wrongdoing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly and find out the truth without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people or criminal trouble, and Christian is uncertain about the truth.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian's belief shifts from possible involvement/complication to Jonathan being an innocent victim of a frame-up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed, and Christian must clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence that proves Jonathan's innocence and clears his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian has identified the real culprit as someone close to both him and Jonathan, and he tells Jonathan this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian is gathering evidence to clear him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian now believes the person behind the frame-up is someone they both know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A trusted mutual acquaintance is the real culprit behind Jonathan's framing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
